programmes.d: Veronica appears on a cable-access show hosted by a psychic as part of the investigation, and Wallace confronts his mother. Plus, Veronica uncovers evidence about the bus crash.
Veronica comes to the aid of the man originally convicted of Lilly Kane's murder, who is now looking for his missing daughter.
Veronica and Duncan discover that a now-comatose Meg had been babysitting an abused child. Meanwhile, Kendall continues her affair with Logan, and Woody makes Keith another offer.
Veronica helps Keith determine who is haunting the parents of a school bus crash victim. Plus, Veronica stumbles into a dangerous situation with the local Irish mob.
Veronica uncovers her mother's permanent record. Trina directs a Neptune High play and immediately dislikes Logan's girlfriend. Plus, Weevil confronts Logan.
Veronica has jury duty, Keith helps the mayor determine who stole from the police station, and a familiar face returns. Plus, one of Veronica's friends meets a tragic end.
An FBI team pursues Duncan after he breaks up with Veronica and flees with Meg's baby. Meanwhile, Wallace reveals the reason he returned to Neptune, and Logan asks Dick for help.
Wallace turns to Veronica for help, and Veronica and Keith stumble upon evidence that links a bus crash victim to their new client. Later, Weevil makes a shocking discovery.
Veronica investigates the theft of money in her possession, Keith confronts his client with questions about the bus crash, and Dick tries to humiliate Beaver.
A blackmailer threatens to publicly expose closeted gay teens, Keith continues to work on Jackie's dad's case, and Logan romantically pursues a sophomore.
Hannah's mother makes an unexpected visit to Everwood to tell Hannah that her father has passed away. Ephram is forced to watch Amy's relationship with Reid grow more serious.
Bright and Amy take Hannah's pending departure harder than they expected. Jake sets out on a high-risk bike trip that takes a near fatal turn.
Ephram discovers that he has unwittingly become a "girlfriend" to Amy, but the friendship takes a turn for something more. Meanwhile, Nina grows suspicious of Jake's recent strange behavior.
Now that a week has passed since they made love, Ephram and Amy must figure out what this development means for their future. Nina and Jake face the biggest obstacle yet in their relationship.

Amy's new college professor and mentor encourages her to get involved with Planned Parenthood. Dr. Abbott and Rose consider adopting a child from Africa.
Although Jake is back from rehab and going to 12-step meetings every night, Nina realizes she has no idea how to deal with his recovery. Dr. Brown cancels a date to give Nina support.
Ephram convinces Kyle to accept the invitation of a pretty classmate to go to a school dance. Meanwhile, an 18-year-old girl asks Dr. Brown to perform a preventative mastectomy.
After Dr. Brown and Jake save an intoxicated driver's life, they disagree over whether to report him to the police. Meanwhile, Ephram convinces Reid to talk to a counselor.
Dr. Brown counsels Ephram not to choose a school just to be near Amy. With things starting to feel back on track, Nina tells Dr. Brown that she plans to propose to Jake.
Upon learning that Bright cheated on Hannah, Ephram is outraged. Meanwhile, Dr. Abbott asks Dr. Brown to protect his lie regarding Rose's cancer.
Veronica investigates a "runaway bride," Veronica and Keith decide to tell Sheriff Lamb about bus crash evidence, and Kendall makes an offer to Logan's imprisoned father.
Veronica runs into her shady ex-boyfriend Troy, who is accused of date rape on campus. Meanwhile, Logan's legal and relationship troubles reach a turning point.
Weevil enlists Veronica's help to prove who killed Felix, and Logan wins the opportunity to intern with the mayor. Later, sparks fly between former couples.
Veronica has dreams about the bus crash, Logan and Weevil work on a physics project that might help Veronica, and Keith investigates a disorder plaguing students.
Veronica tries to identify the person who ran over a senior's dog. Also, Jackie catches Veronica off guard when she asks for her help getting a job at the coffee place.
